7. Prompt Design
To train AI models that can understand requirement speciﬁcations, it is important to provide
them with a large amount of varied data. In real industrial settings, different engineers often
describe the same system in different ways. They may use different words, sentence structures,
or levels of detail, depending on their experience and writing style. These differences do not
change the meaning but affect how the information is presented. For AI models to perform well,
they must be trained on examples that reﬂect this diversity.
